column1: # The applang corpus: each program in the repo that compiles and shows a widget, once
# by the FNV-1a 64 hash of its text, and the variants of each (names renamed, states
# reordered) that compile too. runs: no fault on smoke seeds 1 to 3, icon drawable.
# held: measured, never trained on. Derived: `cargo run -p compusophy-lab --release
# -- corpus` writes it; never edit it by hand.
# 570 programs: 100 found, 470 variants; 391 run clean; 69 held out.
